resolved_findings.title: Late retry approval completion could erase a newer recovery
resolved_findings.reproduction: Canonical retry A settles, its resend journal waits for clearApprovals after releasing the queue; send B fails into the same conversation recovery; A's repeated onSettled could unconditionally clear B recovery.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final a6eb39b stores original draft/recovery ownership and a shared one-time settled flag; later callbacks cannot clear the newer object.
resolved_findings.regressionCase: NMR-UI-01 late retry approval completion cannot erase a newer failed send recovery

resolved_findings.title: Retry inferred ownership from identical current draft content
resolved_findings.reproduction: After A fails, the user edits to a different value then back to A's text, producing a distinct draftId. Resend A previously matched text/attachments and claimed that new current draftId for clearing.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final a6eb39b deletes current-content matching and inherits previous submission ownership; missing prior scope leaves the current draft untouched.
resolved_findings.regressionCase: NMR-UI-01 retry acknowledgement preserves a newer draft with identical text
